shortDescription: Copy a file to a remote cloudengine device over SCP on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: file_system
options.description: The remote file system of the device. If omitted, devices that support a I(file_system) parameter will use their default values. File system indicates the storage medium and can be set to as follows, 1) C(flash) is root directory of the flash memory on the master MPU. 2) C(slave#flash) is root directory of the flash memory on the slave MPU. If no slave MPU exists, this drive is unavailable. 3) C(chassis ID/slot number#flash) is root directory of the flash memory on a device in a stack. For examp

options.name: local_file
options.description: Path to local file. Local directory must exist. The maximum length of I(local_file) is C(4096).

options.name: remote_file
options.description: Remote file path of the copy. Remote directories must exist. If omitted, the name of the local file will be used. The maximum length of I(remote_file) is C(4096).
